dedupe_keys.name: venco py electric vehicle flexibility model

description: venco.py is a Python model from the German Aerospace Center for estimating electricity demand and charging flexibility of electric-vehicle fleets. It combines mobility-demand data with assumptions about vehicles, batteries, charging infrastructure and when drivers plug in. The model produces hourly demand, charge and discharge capacity bounds, battery energy limits and an uncontrolled charging profile. These outputs can become boundary conditions in electricity-system optimization or a representation of vehicle-to-grid potential. Geographic and temporal coverage follow the survey or mobility input and fleet scenario; the software supplies no universal measured charging record. Its GitLab repository and documentation are public under BSD 3-Clause. The tool can help compare grid loading under different fleet mixes and charging policies. A caveat is that behavioural assumptions and charger access can dominate the result, so outputs should be checked against local travel and charging observations. This is distinct from a charging-station asset database. No catalogue or first-review record matched the named GitLab software. The JOSS summary, own project metadata, README and licence were read; no model was run. No directly related catalogue record was established.
